scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run migrate:install-tool && npm run swagger:install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.swagger:gen: go -C apps/api run github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag init -g cmd/api/main.go --output swagger
scripts.dev:backend: npm run swagger:gen && cross-env GO_ENV=development go -C apps/api run ./cmd/api
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env PORT=4000 npm --prefix apps/web run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:frontend: cross-env PORT=4000 npm --prefix apps/web run start
